slides.body: A newer coffee shop on Main Road. Espresso drinks and pastries, plus a kitchen for plates and toasts until 2 PM.

slides.title: Cafe Club
slides.body: An Italian-style coffee shop with cappuccino and panini. Sit inside or on the patio.

slides.title: Landauer Cafe
slides.body: A cafe and bakery on Main Road in the Towaco section, known for German-style baked goods.
